parameters.unit: level-1 pendant cords attached to a primary cord

reading_the_numbers: gain_bits_per_cord is the saving over predicting the cord from its khipu's own frequencies; it can be negative when a context splits the counts without helping.
null_* repeat the measurement after shuffling the hidden feature among the cords of each khipu; p_upper cannot go below 1/(trials+1).
excess_bits_per_cord is the gain minus the shuffle mean: the part of the saving that depends on which cord carries which value.
cluster_null_* and excess_within_cluster repeat that for feature-to-feature links with values shuffled only inside their own cord cluster.
A recorded link can come from how a khipu was made, how it survived, or how it was catalogued. This test cannot tell those apart.
